title: Record the two-hub tariff minimum
body:
## Summary
- The retained 21-premise literal actual-reader model has minimum charge 54: seven source rows pay one unit, six reader premises pay two, and the other eight reader rows pay one.
- The retained witness charges `4, 8, 12, 4, 10, 8, 0, 4, 4` also sum to 54. The baseline of 42 is unattained in this model. The selected kappa is unchanged.
- Partial result, no new kappa. This is the minimum of this fixed model.
